import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] degs = new long[20]; // indices 1..18 used

    static long rec(long cur, int d) {
        cur = Math.abs(cur);
        if (cur % degs[d] == 0)
            return cur / degs[d] * d;
        long k = cur / degs[d];
        long temp1 = k * d + rec(cur - k * degs[d], d - 1);
        long temp2 = (k + 1) * d + rec((k + 1) * degs[d] - cur, d - 1);
        return Math.min(temp1, temp2);
    }

    static void run() {
        degs[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 17; i++)
            degs[i + 2] = degs[i + 1] * 10 + 1;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(rec(n, 18));
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        run();
    }
}
